description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dto'. It extends 'DateRangeSearchFilterParams' and provides filtering parameters related to leave comments, including allowed sort fields and a leave ID property.

classes.name: LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for filtering leave comment searches based on date range and leave ID. It specifies allowed sorting fields and provides getter and setter methods for leave ID.

methods.name: getLeaveId
methods.description: Getter method that returns the leave ID filter value, which can be null.

methods.name: setLeaveId
methods.description: Setter method to assign a leave ID to the filter parameters; accepts an integer or null.
